announcements.headline: Proposed Delisting and Listing on AIM
announcements.insight: Following recent subscription agreements, Beacon Rise Holdings proposes moving to AIM. This listing change may alter liquidity and investor profile for existing shareholders.

announcements.headline: ASA funding of £50k
announcements.insight: Beacon Rise Holdings confirms a further £50k ASA investment in October, following the initial £66,888 offer announced in September.

announcements.headline: Circ re.further ASA investment of £50k
announcements.insight: Beacon Rise Holdings confirms a further £50k investment under its Advanced Subscription Agreement, following earlier filings in June and July. This continues the capital raise process initiated last year.

announcements.headline: Half-year Financial Report
announcements.insight: Beacon Rise Holdings publishes its half-year financial report following recent subscription investments. Shareholders should monitor how these funds impact the reported results.

announcements.headline: Advanced Subscription Agreement to raise £66,888
announcements.insight: Beacon Rise Holdings raises £66,888 via an Advanced Subscription Agreement. This follows earlier filings in June and July regarding further investment.

announcements.headline: Doc re. ASA subscription investment
announcements.insight: Beacon Rise Holdings continues its ASA subscription investment process, following earlier updates in June and July. Shareholders should monitor for further developments regarding this ongoing transaction.

announcements.headline: Circ re. Further investment
announcements.insight: Beacon Rise Holdings confirms a further investment in New ASA. This follows the June announcement, indicating continued engagement in this specific asset.

announcements.headline: Further re New ASA investment
announcements.insight: Beacon Rise Holdings provides a further update regarding its New ASA investment. Shareholders should monitor subsequent filings for details on the investment's status or any resulting financial impact.
